title: The room and the man
content: Because I keep apparently ,somehow, deleting my posts by stupidity here's one more try. Whenever I land in Mallworld, be it hotel, school, mansion or mall, I always always always end up in this room. It's always the same and always smells of some fragrant spice I can't identify in my waking life. Sometimes I'm in this room alone and wind up going to sleep there. Sometimes the man who lives in this room is there. He's very young, except when he's very old. He says his age is meaningless, that he's always been there, he's been dying since the beginning of time, and his name is Ryan. He has a metal thing bolted into his skull that he says is connected to telemetry. That always strikes me as very important. I find him beautiful and kind, and extremely wise. Other people within the dream find him scary, and say it's unwise to make him angry. I'd love to know if anyone has run into him, and any thoughts on who my infinitely dying guru might be. I'd also really love to know if anyone has seen his room. After a long fight with image creation I've got a much more reasonable rendering of what he actually looks like. (The previous image looked like him if he were a supermodel) The room is perfect. Idk how that's a thing, a perfect image of a room from a dream, but here we are.
